name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  induction post <;> simp [substOld]
  case fvar => intros x Hin; simp_all
  case op => exact List.Subset.empty
  case const => exact List.Subset.empty
  case bvar => intros x Hin; contradiction
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    apply List.Subset.app
    · apply List.Subset.trans
      apply cih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
      cases Hin <;> simp_all
    apply List.Subset.app
    · apply List.Subset.trans
      apply tih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
      cases Hin <;> simp_all
    · apply List.Subset.trans
      apply eih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    · split
      · simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
      · simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
        intros x Hin
        exact ih2 Hin
    · simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, imp_false, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
      apply List.Subset.app
      · apply List.Subset.trans
        apply ih1 <;> assumption
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
        cases Hin <;> simp_all
      · apply List.Subset.trans
        apply ih2 <;> assumption
        intros x Hin
        grind
  case quant trih eih =>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    apply List.Subset.app
    · apply List.Subset.trans
      apply trih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      rename_i m1 k1 ty1 trigger1 e1
      simp_all
      cases Hin <;> simp_all
    · apply List.Subset.trans
      apply eih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    apply List.Subset.app
    · apply List.Subset.trans
      apply ih1 <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
      cases Hin <;> simp_all
    · apply List.Subset.trans
      apply ih2 <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all

name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro h
  have append_mono {α} {a b c d : List α}
      (ha : a ⊆ c) (hb : b ⊆ d) : (a ++ b) ⊆ (c ++ d) :=
    List.append_subset.mpr ⟨List.subset_append_of_subset_left d ha,
      List.subset_append_of_subset_right c hb⟩
  induction h with
  | const | op | bvar | fvar =>
      simp [extractOldExprVars]
  | abs hn ih => assumption
  | quant htr he ihtr ihe => exact append_mono ihtr ihe
  | app hfn he valid ihfn ihe =>
      unfold extractOldExprVars
      split
      · simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars,
          List.Subset]
      · next Hfalse =>
        exfalso
        cases valid (by constructor)
        apply Hfalse
        rfl
      · exact append_mono ihfn ihe
  | ite hc ht he ihc iht ihe => exact append_mono (append_mono ihc iht) ihe
  | eq h1 h2 ih1 ih2 => exact append_mono ih1 ih2

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro Hup Hinit
  have hlen' := InitStatesLength Hinit
  refine ⟨_, rfl,
    updatedStatesInit hlen'
      (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup)
      (InitStatesNodup Hinit), ?_⟩
  have hlen := UpdateStatesLength Hup
  have hdisj : (ks.zip vs).unzip.1.Disjoint (ks'.zip vs').unzip.1 := by
    rw [List.unzip_zip hlen, List.unzip_zip hlen']
    intro k hk hk'
    simpa [InitStatesNotDefined Hinit k hk'] using
      UpdateStatesDefined Hup k hk
  rw [InitStatesUpdated Hinit, UpdateStatesUpdated Hup]
  simp [updatedStates, updatedStatesComm (σ := σ) hdisj]
  exact updatedStatesUpdate hlen (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' Hup))

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  -- assume ¬(f = 0)
    rw [funext_iff]; by_contra h₀
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx0⟩ := not_forall.1 h₀
    simp at hx0 -- hx0 : f x₀ ≠ 0

  -- [1] Proof that `f` is continuous at `x₀`.
  -- Embed into the true IP-space `WithLp 2 V`.
  -- Continuity of the scalar product itself gives positivity nearby.
    let q : Y → ℝ := fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ
    have hinner_cont : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
      Continuous.inner' (f : Y → V) (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
    have hself : 0 < q x₀ := by
      have hnn : 0 ≤ q x₀ := by
        simpa [q] using (real_inner_self_nonneg' (F := V) (x := f x₀))
      have hne : q x₀ ≠ 0 := by exact Core.inner_self_ne_zero.mpr hx0
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne hnn (Ne.symm hne)
    have hpos : IsOpen {x : Y | 0 < q x} := isOpen_Ioi.preimage hinner_cont
    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂_pos, hδ₂⟩ :=
      Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hpos.mem_nhds hself)
    have inner_pos₂ : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ₂), 0 < q x :=
      fun x hx => hδ₂ hx
  -- [3] `g` construction using bump function.
    haveI : HasContDiffBump Y := hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace Y
    let φ1 : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ₂ / 4, δ₂ / 2, by positivity, by linarith⟩
    let φ : Y → ℝ := φ1.toFun
    have hφ_testfun : IsTestFunction φ := ⟨φ1.contDiff, φ1.hasCompactSupport⟩
    have hφ_non_neg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x := fun x => φ1.nonneg
    have hφ_support_subset : Function.support φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ (δ₂/2) := by
      change Function.support φ1.toFun ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ (δ₂/2)
      rw [ContDiffBump.support_eq]
    have hφ_pos_inner : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (δ₂/4), 0 < φ x := by
      intro x hx
      apply φ1.pos_of_mem_ball
      exact Metric.mem_ball.mpr
        (lt_of_le_of_lt hx (by show δ₂ / 4 < δ₂ / 2; linarith))
    have key_integral : ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0 := by
      simpa only [inner_smul_right'] using
        hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀) (IsTestFunction.smul_right hφ_testfun contDiff_const)

  -- [4.2] 0 < ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ. Sketch: on the support of φ (which is contained in
  -- B(x₀, δ/2) ⊆ B(x₀, δ)), we have ⟪f x, f x₀⟫ > ‖f x₀‖²/2 > 0 by our choice of δ.
  -- Since φ is nonnegative on its support and positive somewhere, this gives the contradiction.

  -- [4.2.1] Integrability of the integrand: `integrable_prod` .
    have support_subset : Function.support φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ δ₂ :=
      hφ_support_subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith))
    have supp_subset2 : Function.support (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) ⊆ Function.support φ := by simp
    have integrable_prod :
      Integrable (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) μ :=
    -- (i) build a `HasCompactSupport` witness for the product
      (Continuous.mul hφ_testfun.smooth.continuous hinner_cont).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (hφ_testfun.supp.mono supp_subset2)

  -- [4.2.2] Nonnegativity everywhere (`h_nonneg`)
    have h_nonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Function.support φ
      · -- on the support, φ ≥ 0 and ⟪f x, f x₀⟫ > 0
        exact mul_nonneg (hφ_non_neg x) (inner_pos₂ x (support_subset hx)).le
      · -- off the support, φ x = 0 so the product is 0
        simp [Function.notMem_support.mp hx]

  -- [4.2.3] That closed ball has positive measure, and is contained in the support
    -- every nonempty open set has positive measure
    have hμ_ball : 0 < μ (Metric.ball x₀ (δ₂/4)) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.measure_pos μ (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr (by positivity))
    have ball_subset_support :
        Metric.ball x₀ (δ₂/4)
          ⊆ Function.support (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := by
        intro x hx
        have hφx := hφ_pos_inner x (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx)
        have hin : 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
          inner_pos₂ x (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hx)
        simp only [Function.support_mul]
        exact ⟨ne_of_gt hφx, ne_of_gt hin⟩

  -- [4.2.4] putting everything together: positivity contradicts `key_integral : ∫ ... = 0`
    have integral_pos : 0 < ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ :=
      (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg h_nonneg integrable_prod).mpr
        (lt_of_lt_of_le hμ_ball
          (measure_mono ball_subset_support))
    linarith

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ
      (fun s => ∂[j] (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i
  calc _
    _= ∂ₜ (fun t =>
      1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, Space.deriv j (fun x => magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c A t x (j, i)) x -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity 𝓕.c J t x i) t := by
        conv_lhs =>
          enter [1]
          change fun t => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) t
          enter [t]
          rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
            (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
            time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∂ₜ (fun t => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x) t -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      rw [Time.deriv_eq]
      rw [fderiv_fun_sub]
      simp only
      rw [fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt]
      rw [fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt]
      rfl
      · exact ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
      · exact hJt.differentiableAt.const_mul _
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ((∑ j, ∂ₜ (fun t => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x)) t) -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * (∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t) := by
      congr
      rw [Time.deriv_eq]
      rw [fderiv_fun_sum fun i _ => (hBt i).differentiableAt]
      simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
      rfl
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∑ j, ∂[j] (fun x => ∂ₜ (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c · x (j, i)) t)) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      congr
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
      congr
      funext k
      rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv]
      apply magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff
      apply hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) *(∑ j, ∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x -
        ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x)) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
        congr
        funext k
        congr
        funext x
        rw [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out))]
    _ = (1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x -
          ∂[j] (fun x => ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x)) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
        congr
        funext j
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        rw [fderiv_fun_sub (hEd _ _).differentiableAt (hEd _ _).differentiableAt]
        rfl
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by simp only [ Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
        1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[i] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        funext j
        rw [Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs _)]
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∂[i] (fun x => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        rw [fderiv_fun_sum]
        simp only [_root_.sum_apply, ← deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        intro j _
        exact (hEd j j).differentiableAt
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∂[i] (fun x => (∇ ⬝ (A.electricField 𝓕.c t)) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        rfl
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀ ^ 2) * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr 2
        rw [isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix] at h

        conv_lhs =>
          enter [2, 2, x]
          rw [(h t x).1]
        trans 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * Space.deriv i
            (fun x => (1/ 𝓕.ε₀) * LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity 𝓕.c J t x) x
        · congr
          funext x
          ring
        · rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
          rw [fderiv_const_mul]
          simp only [ _root_.smul_apply, ← deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
          apply Differentiable.differentiableAt
          apply LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
          exact hJ.differentiable (by decide)
        · exact hA
        · exact hJ
      _ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
            𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
            𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
          simp only [ FreeSpace.c_sq]
          field_simp

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let spanSet : Submodule ℂ 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra := Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)
  let p (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (_ : a ∈ spanSet) (_ : b ∈ spanSet) : Prop :=
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b))
  change p a b (Basis.mem_span _ a) (Basis.mem_span _ b)
  apply Submodule.span_induction₂
  · rintro x y ⟨φs', rfl⟩ ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    let sl := List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)
    let before := List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c) sl
    let both := fun c => decide (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
    let bothL := List.filter both φs'
    let bothR := List.filter both φs
    let after := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) sl
    let u := ι (ofCrAnListF before)
    let v := ι (ofCrAnListF bothL)
    let w := ι (ofCrAnListF bothR)
    let z := ι (ofCrAnListF after)
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, p]
    calc _
      /- Split the commutator. -/
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
        ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
          crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs) •
        𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs))) := by
        conv_lhs =>
          rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
            superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
          rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [map_smul, sub_right_inj]
        module
      /- Simplify the signs. -/
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
        (ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
        𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)))) := by
        rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
        module
      /- Splitting the time-ordered lists. -/
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
        (u *
            v *
            ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) *
            w *
            z -
        𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
        u *
            v *
            ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) *
            w *
            z) := by
        have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs
          (by simp_all)
        rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp, h1]
        have h2 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs
          (by simp_all)
        rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs by norm_num, h2]
        simp only [ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, before, bothL, bothR, after, sl, both, u, v, w, z]
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
          (u *
            v *
            (ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) - 𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
              ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ])) *
            w *
            z) := by
          simp only [
  Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, mul_sub, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, sub_mul]
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
          (u *
            v *
            ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
            w *
            z) := by
          congr
          rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
            ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
          simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul]
    rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
    simp only [ z]
    repeat rw [mul_assoc]
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
      ← ofCrAnListF_append]
    have h1 := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h1 ⊢
    rw [← h1, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
    by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
    · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
    · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (by grind only),
        ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
      simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
  all_goals simp_all only [map_mul, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, add_mul, map_add,
    mul_add, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, implies_true, p]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l with val_l | ⟨t₁', red_l⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl r with val_r | ⟨t₂', red_r⟩
      · obtain ⟨σ, u, h⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
        use u ^ᵗᵗ t₂
        grind
      · exact ⟨t₁.app t₂', Red.appᵣ val_l red_r⟩
    · exact ⟨t₁'.app t₂, Red.appₗ r.wf.2.1 red_l⟩
  case tapp σ' d sub ih =>
    have lcσ : σ'.LC := (sub.wf [] σ' _).2.1.lc
    right
    rcases ih rfl d with val | ⟨u, step⟩
    · obtain ⟨δ, v, h⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs val
      exact ⟨v ^ᵗᵞ σ', by grind⟩
    · exact ⟨.tapp u σ', Red.tapp lcσ step⟩
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der h ih _ =>
    have ⟨_, hb⟩ := Term.body_let.mp (Typing.let' L der h).wf.2.1
    right
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t₁', step⟩
    · exact ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁, Red.let_body val hb⟩
    · exact ⟨t₁'.let' t₂, Red.let_bind step hb⟩
  case inl der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨u, step⟩
    · grind
    · exact Or.inr ⟨.inl u, Red.inl step⟩
  case inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨u, step⟩
    · grind
    · exact Or.inr ⟨.inr u, Red.inr step⟩
  case case t₁ σ τ t₂ δ t₃ L der h₂ h₃ ih _ _ =>
    have ⟨_, hb₂, hb₃⟩ := Term.body_case.mp (Typing.case L der h₂ h₃).wf.2.1
    right
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨u, step⟩
    · rcases der.canonical_form_sum val with ⟨v, h | h⟩
      · subst t₁
        cases val with
        | inl vv => exact ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ v, Red.case_inl vv hb₂ hb₃⟩
      · subst t₁
        cases val with
        | inr vv => exact ⟨t₃ ^ᵗᵗ v, Red.case_inr vv hb₂ hb₃⟩
    · exact ⟨.case u t₂ t₃, Red.case step hb₂ hb₃⟩
  case sub => grind
  case abs => grind
  case tabs => grind

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  have join_refl (x) : Join ParallelReduction x x := ⟨x, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  cases h₁
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha' hb' =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha' hb'⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha'' hb'' =>
      rcases parallelReduction_diamond ha' ha'' with ⟨a₃, ha₁, ha₂⟩
      rcases parallelReduction_diamond hb' hb'' with ⟨b₃, hb₁, hb₂⟩
      exact ⟨a₃ ⬝ b₃, .par ha₁ hb₁, .par ha₂ hb₂⟩
    case red_I =>
      rcases I_irreducible a' ha' with rfl
      exact ⟨b', .red_I b', hb'⟩
    case red_K =>
      rcases Ka_irreducible a₂ a' ha' with ⟨a₂', ha₂', rfl⟩
      exact ⟨a₂', .red_K .., ha₂'⟩
    case red_S a c =>
      rcases Sab_irreducible a c a' ha' with ⟨a'', c', ha, hc, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨a'' ⬝ b' ⬝ (c' ⬝ b'), .red_S a'' c' b', .par (.par ha hb') (.par hc hb')⟩
  case red_I =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a₁, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    case par c a₁' hc ha =>
      rcases I_irreducible c hc with rfl
      exact ⟨a₁', ha, .red_I _⟩
    case red_I => exact join_refl _
  case red_K c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K ..⟩
    case par a' c' ha hc =>
      rcases Ka_irreducible a₁ a' ha with ⟨a₁', h', rfl⟩
      exact ⟨a₁', h', .red_K ..⟩
    case red_K => exact join_refl _
  case red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    case par d c' hd hc =>
      rcases Sab_irreducible a b d hd with ⟨a', b', ha, hb, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨a' ⬝ c' ⬝ (b' ⬝ c'), .par (.par ha hc) (.par hb hc), .red_S ..⟩
    case red_S => exact join_refl _

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨(fun s t => s ~[lts (defs := defs)] t ∨
    (s = choice p r ∧ t = choice q r)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp
  · intro s t hr μ
    rcases hr with hb | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · constructor
      · intro s' hs
        obtain ⟨t', ht, hb'⟩ := hb.follow_fst hs
        exact ⟨t', ht, Or.inl hb'⟩
      · intro t' ht
        obtain ⟨s', hs, hb'⟩ := hb.follow_snd ht
        exact ⟨s', hs, Or.inl hb'⟩
    · constructor
      · intro s' hs
        cases hs with
        | choiceL hp =>
            obtain ⟨q', hq, hb'⟩ := h.follow_fst hp
            exact ⟨q', Tr.choiceL hq, Or.inl hb'⟩
        | choiceR hr =>
            exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR hr, Or.inl (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
      · intro t' ht
        cases ht with
        | choiceL hq =>
            obtain ⟨p', hp, hb'⟩ := h.follow_snd hq
            exact ⟨p', Tr.choiceL hp, Or.inl hb'⟩
        | choiceR hr =>
            exact ⟨t', Tr.choiceR hr, Or.inl (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let C_i := (BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_H := Code.distFromCode f C_i
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 (⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_i_plus_steps := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩

  have h_d_i_gt_0 : d_i > 0 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, d_i]
    omega

  have h_C_i_nonempty : Nonempty C_i := ⟨0, C_i.zero_mem⟩

  obtain ⟨g', h_g'_mem, h_g'_min_card⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i, d_fw
    = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    let S := (fun (g : C_i) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
      f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
    have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty
    rcases Nat.sInf_mem hS_nonempty with ⟨g, _, h⟩
    exact ⟨g.val, g.property, h.symm⟩

  have h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size : (hammingDist f g' : ℕ∞) ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    change (Δ₀(f, g') : ℕ∞) ≤ ↑d_fw * ((2 ^ steps : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
    rw [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_le_coe, h_g'_min_card]
    set ΔH := Finset.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x) Finset.univ
    set Y_bad := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    letI : Fintype Y_bad := Fintype.ofFinite ↑Y_bad
    have h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points : ΔH ⊆ Finset.biUnion Y_bad.toFinset
        (t := fun y => ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''
          (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ((2:ℕ)^steps)))).toFinset) := by
      intro x hx_in_ΔH
      simp only [mem_filter, ΔH] at hx_in_ΔH
      let y_of_x := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      use y_of_x
      have h_elemenet_Y_bad : y_of_x ∈ Y_bad.toFinset := by
        simp only [fiberwiseDisagreementSet, iteratedQuotientMap, ne_eq, Subtype.exists,
          Set.toFinset_setOf, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Y_bad]
        let X := x.val
        have h_X_in_source : X ∈ sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) := by
          exact Submodule.coe_mem x
        use X
        use h_X_in_source
        have h_forward_iterated_qmap : Polynomial.eval X
            (intermediateNormVpoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨↑i, by omega⟩
              ⟨steps, by simp only; omega⟩) = y_of_x := by
          rfl
        have h_eval_diff : f ⟨X, by omega⟩ ≠ g' ⟨X, by omega⟩ := by
          unfold X
          simp only [Subtype.coe_eta, ne_eq, hx_in_ΔH, not_false_eq_true]
        simp only [h_forward_iterated_qmap, Subtype.coe_eta, h_eval_diff, not_false_eq_true, and_self]
      simp only [h_elemenet_Y_bad]
      set qMapFiber := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y_of_x)
      simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range, mem_image, mem_univ, true_and]
      use (pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (x := x))
      exact is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps (by omega)
        (x := x) (y := y_of_x).mp (by rfl)
    apply (Finset.card_le_card h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points).trans
    rw [Finset.card_biUnion]
    · simp only [Set.toFinset_card]
      have h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point := card_qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β
        (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i steps h_i_add_steps
      simp only [Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset, Subtype.forall]
        at h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point
      have h_card_fiber_of_each_y : ∀ y ∈ Y_bad.toFinset,
          Fintype.card ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨↑i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
            (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''
            ↑(Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ((2:ℕ)^steps)))) = 2 ^ steps := by
        intro y hy_in_Y_bad
        have hy_card_fiber_of_y := h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point (a := y) (b := by
          exact Submodule.coe_mem y)
        simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset, hy_card_fiber_of_y]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_card_fiber_of_each_y]
      simp only [sum_const, Set.toFinset_card, smul_eq_mul, ge_iff_le]
      conv_rhs => rw [←_root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
      simp only [card_eq_fintype_card, le_refl]
    · intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ hy_ne
      have h_disjoint := qMap_total_fiber_disjoint (i := ⟨↑i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (y₁ := y₁) (y₂ := y₂) (hy_ne := hy_ne)
      simp only [coe_univ]
      exact h_disjoint

  have h_dist_bridge : d_H ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    apply le_trans (a := d_H) (c := d_fw * 2 ^ steps) (b := hammingDist f g')
    · simp only [distFromCode, SetLike.mem_coe, hammingDist, ne_eq, d_H]
      apply sInf_le
      use g'
    · exact h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size

  have h_fw_bound : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_i_plus_steps - 1 := by
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)

  have h_algebraic_identity : (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one, d_i_plus_steps, d_i]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add]
    congr 2 <;> omega

  have h_dH_ne_top : d_H ≠ ⊤ := by
    simp only [ne_eq, d_H]
    rw [Code.distFromCode_eq_top_iff_empty f C_i]
    exact Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty'.mp h_C_i_nonempty

  let d_H_nat := ENat.toNat d_H
  have h_dH_eq : d_H = d_H_nat := (ENat.coe_toNat h_dH_ne_top).symm

  have h_final_inequality : 2 * d_H_nat ≤ d_i - 1 := by
    have h_bridge_nat : d_H_nat ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
      rw [←ENat.coe_le_coe]
      exact le_of_eq_of_le (id (Eq.symm h_dH_eq)) h_dist_bridge
    calc 2 * d_H_nat
      _ ≤ 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) := by gcongr
      _ = (2 * d_fw) * 2 ^ steps := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps := by gcongr
      _ = d_i - 1 := h_algebraic_identity

  simp only [d_H, d_H_nat] at h_dH_eq
  rw [h_dH_eq]
  change ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * ↑Δ₀(f, C_i).toNat <
    ↑(BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i, by omega⟩)
  rw [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_lt_coe]
  apply Nat.lt_of_le_pred (n := 2 * Δ₀(f, C_i).toNat) (m := d_i) (h := h_d_i_gt_0)
    (h_final_inequality)

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  simp only
  intro y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  set x₀ := fiberMap 0
  set x₁ := fiberMap 1
  set P_i := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) coeffs
  set new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw []
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1)) (i := 1)
      · omega
      · omega
    ⟩)
  have h_eval_qMap_x₀ : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval x₀.val = y := by
    have h := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) x₀
    simp only [Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    rw [h.symm]
    have h_res := is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i (steps := 1) (by omega)
      (x := x₀) (y := y).mpr (by rw [pointToIterateQuotientIndex_qMap_total_fiber_eq_self])
    rw [h_res]
    -- exact qMap_eval_fiber_eq_self ⟦L⟧ ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ (by simp only; omega) h_i_succ_lt y 0
  have h_eval_qMap_x₁ : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval x₁.val = y := by

    rw [h.symm]
    have h_res := is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i (steps := 1) (by omega)
      (x := x₁) (y := y).mpr (by rw [pointToIterateQuotientIndex_qMap_total_fiber_eq_self])
    rw [h_res]
  have h_fiber_diff : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    let ii : Fin r := ⟨i.val, Nat.lt_trans i.isLt
      (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡) h_ℓ_add_R_rate)⟩
    let jj : Fin r := ⟨i.val + 1, by
      have hnext : i.val + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡 := by simpa using h_i_succ_lt
      exact Nat.lt_trans hnext h_ℓ_add_R_rate
    ⟩
    have h_ij : ii ≤ jj := Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr (by omega)
    have hii : ii < ℓ + 𝓡 := by
      simpa [ii] using Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡)
    have hjj : jj < ℓ + 𝓡 := by simpa [jj] using h_i_succ_lt
    let b := sDomain_basis 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ii hii
    let z := sDomain.lift 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ii jj hjj h_ij y
    
    let e0 : Fin (ℓ + 𝓡 - ii) := ⟨0, by simpa [ii] using hdim⟩
    have h0 := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y (0 : Fin 2)
    have h1 := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y (1 : Fin 2)
    have h0' : x₀ = (0 : 𝔽q) • b e0 + z := by
      simpa [x₀, fiberMap, Fin2ToF2, b, z, ii, jj, h_ij] using h0
    have h1' : x₁ = (1 : 𝔽q) • b e0 + z := by
      simpa [x₁, fiberMap, Fin2ToF2, b, z, ii, jj, h_ij] using h1
    have hb : (b e0 : L) = 1 := by
      dsimp [b]
      exact get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ii hii
    have h0v := congrArg (fun x : sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ii => (x : L)) h0'
    have h1v := congrArg (fun x : sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ii => (x : L)) h1'
    simp only [Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul] at h0v h1v
    rw [h0v, h1v]
    rw [hb]
    simp
  set P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  -- Set up the even and odd refinement polynomials
  set P₀_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) => coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
    have h1 : ℓ - (i + 1) + 1 = ℓ - i := by omega
    have h2 : 2^(ℓ - (i + 1) + 1) = 2^(ℓ - i) := by rw [h1]
    
    rw []; omega⟩
  set P₁_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) => coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
    have h1 : ℓ - (i + 1) + 1 = ℓ - i := by omega
    have h2 : 2^(ℓ - (i + 1) + 1) = 2^(ℓ - i) := by rw [h1]
    
    rw []; omega⟩
  set P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_P_i_eval := evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs
  -- Equation 39 : P^(i)(X) = P₀^(i+1)(q^(i)(X)) + X · P₁^(i+1)(q^(i)(X))
  have h_equation_39_x₀ : P_i.eval x₀.val = P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [h_P_i_eval, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
      h_eval_qMap_x₀, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P_i, P₀, P₁]
  have h_equation_39_x₁ : P_i.eval x₁.val = P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [h_P_i_eval, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
      h_eval_qMap_x₁, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P_i, P₀, P₁]
  set f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩) => P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  set f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  -- Unfold the definition of f_i_plus_1 using the fold function
  
  -- Main calculation following the outline
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
    = f_i x₀ * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        f_i x₁ * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := rfl
    _ = P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by dsimp
    _ = (P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val) * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        (P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val) * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by
      rw [h_equation_39_x₀, h_equation_39_x₁]
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal + r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) +
        P₁.eval y.val * (x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
          x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val)) := by ring
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * ((1 - r_chal) * (x₁.val - x₀.val)) +
        P₁.eval y.val * ((x₁.val - x₀.val) * r_chal) := by ring
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal := by rw [h_fiber_diff]; ring
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P_i_plus_1, P₀, P₁, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      conv_lhs => enter [1]; rw [mul_comm, ←Polynomial.eval_C_mul]
      conv_lhs => enter [2]; rw [mul_comm, ←Polynomial.eval_C_mul]
      -- ⊢ eval y (C (1-r) * ∑...) + eval y (C r * ∑...) = eval y (∑...)
      rw [←Polynomial.eval_add]
      -- ⊢ poly_left.eval y = poly_right.eval y
      congr
      simp_rw [mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      -- We now prove that the terms inside the sums are equal for each index.
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      have h_j_lt : j.val < 2 ^ (ℓ - (↑i + 1)) := by
        rw [Nat.sub_add_eq]
        omega
      conv_lhs => enter [1]; rw [mul_comm (a := Polynomial.C (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
        rw []
        apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
          (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)⟩)), ←mul_assoc,
        mul_comm (a := Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal))]; rw [mul_assoc]
      conv_lhs => enter [2]; rw [mul_comm (a := Polynomial.C (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
        apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
          (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)⟩)), ←mul_assoc,
        mul_comm (a := Polynomial.C r_chal)]; rw [mul_assoc]
      conv_rhs => rw [mul_comm]
      rw [←mul_add]
      congr
      simp only [←Polynomial.C_mul, ←Polynomial.C_add]

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
    classical
    intro ϑ
    induction ϑ with
    | zero =>
      intro u
      contradiction
    | succ ϑ_sub_1 ih =>
      cases ϑ_sub_1 with
      | zero =>
        -- `ϑ = 1`
        simp only [zero_add, zero_lt_one, forall_const]
        intro u
        let toAffineLineEval := multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (u := u)
        intro hprob_gt
        simp_rw [toAffineLineEval] at hprob_gt
        let prob_eq := prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
          (P := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e)
        -- Convert sampling (r ← (Fin 1 → F)) into sampling (r ← F)
        simp_rw [prob_eq, Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hprob_gt
        have h_correlated_agreement := hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hprob_gt
        simp only [jointProximityNat₂] at h_correlated_agreement
        have h_u_eq: u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
          funext rowIdx
          match rowIdx with
          | 0 => rfl
          | 1 => rfl
        rw [h_u_eq.symm] at h_correlated_agreement
        exact h_correlated_agreement
      | succ ϑ_sub_2 =>
        intro hϑ_gt_0 u hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        -- `ϑ ≥ 2`
        -- set ϑ_sub_1 := ϑ_sub_2 + 1
        
        
        -- have hfinϑ : Fin ϑ = Fin (ϑ_sub_2 + 1 + 1) := by rfl
        set U₀ : Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)) → Word A ι :=
          (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1) u).1
        set U₁ : Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)) → Word A ι :=
          (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1) u).2
        unfold jointProximityNat
        simp only
        -- intro hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        have h_finsnoc_eq_r: ∀ r: Fin (ϑ_sub_2 + 1 + 1) → F,
          Fin.snoc (fun (i : Fin (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)) ↦ r i.castSucc)
            (r (Fin.last (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) = r := by
          intro r
          funext i
          refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
          · simp
          · simp
        let P : F → (Fin (ϑ_sub_2 + 1) → F) → Prop := fun r_last r_init =>
          Δ₀(multilinearCombine (u:=u) (r:=Fin.snoc r_init r_last), MC) ≤ e
        let hP_split_r_last := prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
          (ϑ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1) (F := F) (P := P)
        unfold P at hP_split_r_last
        simp_rw [h_finsnoc_eq_r] at hP_split_r_last
        rw [hP_split_r_last] at hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        -- Now we have two randomness sampling in hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt :
        -- `((ϑ_sub_2 + 1 + 1) * ε) / |𝔽|
          -- < Pr_{ r_last; r_init }[  Δ₀((Fin.snoc r_init r_last)|⨂|u, ↑MC) ≤ ↑e)) ]` (0)
        -- We need to achieve the upperbound for hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt probability by:
        -- i.e. `Pr_{ r_last; r_init }[  Δ₀((Fin.snoc r_init r_last)|⨂|u, ↑MC) ≤ ↑e)) ]`
        -- `= Pr_{ r_last; r_init }[ Δ₀((r_init)|⨂|affineCombine(U₀, U₁, r_last), ↑MC) ≤ ↑e)) ]`
        -- `= PR_{ r_last }[ r_init; Δ₀((r_init)|⨂|affineCombine(U₀, U₁, r_last), ↑MC) ≤ ↑e)) ]`
        -- Divide into two cases: r_last ∈ R* and r_last ∉ R*
        -- `= Pr_{ r_last }[ r_last ∈ R* ∧
          -- Pr_{ r_init }[ Δ₀((r_init)|⨂|affineCombine(U₀, U₁, r_last), ↑MC) ≤ ↑e)) ]` (1)
        -- `+ Pr_{ r_last }[ r_last ∉ R* ∧
          -- Pr_{ r_init }[ Δ₀((r_init)|⨂|affineCombine(U₀, U₁, r_last), ↑MC) ≤ ↑e)) ]` (2)
        -- `(1) = Pr_{ r_last }[ r_last ∈ R* ]` (3)
        -- `(2): ∀ r ∉ R*, it's trivial that the probability
          -- ≤ ((ϑ_sub_2 + 1) * ε) / |𝔽|, due to definition of membership of R*` (4)

        -- Combine (0), (3), (4): we have `Pr_{ r_last }[ r_last ∈ R* ] > ε/|𝔽|` (5)

        -- Applying `correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor` to (5), we get
          -- `Δ₀((r_last)|⨂|affineCombine(U₀, U₁, r_last), ↑MC) ≤ ↑e)) ] > ε/|𝔽|` (6)
        -- This is premise for affineProxmityGaps of interleaved code (`h_interleaved_gaps`)
          -- for `m = 2^{ϑ_sub_2 + 1}`, which directly leads to Q.E.D.
        let  ϑ_pred := ϑ_sub_2 + 1
        
        
        -- Step 1: Apply multilinearCombine recursive form
        -- We need the lemma `multilinearCombine u r = multilinearCombine`
          -- `(affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r_last) r_init` where `r = Fin.snoc r_init r_last`
        have multilinearCombine_snoc_eq_multilinearCombine_affine
          (r_init : Fin ϑ_pred → F) (r_last : F) : multilinearCombine u (Fin.snoc r_init r_last) =
            multilinearCombine (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r_last) r_init := by
          rw [multilinearCombine_recursive_form]
          simp only [Fin.snoc_last, Fin.init_snoc]
          rfl
        -- Rewrite the probability using this identity
        simp_rw [multilinearCombine_snoc_eq_multilinearCombine_affine]
          at hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        -- hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt now looks like:
        -- Pr_{ r_last ← $ᵖ F; r_init ← $ᵖ (Fin ϑ_pred → F) }[ Δ₀(multilinearCombine
            -- (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r_last) r_init, ↑MC) ≤ ↑e ] > ↑(↑ϑ * ↑ε) / q
        -- Step 2 & 3: Define R* and apply Law of Total Probability
        let R_star_set := R_star_tensor MC (m:=ϑ_pred) (e:=e) (ε:=ε) U₀ U₁
        -- Step 5: Show Pr[R*] > ε / q
        have h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q : Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[ r ∈ R_star_set ]
          > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
          exact prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) (ϑ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1) (u := u)
            (e := e) (hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt)
        -- Convert Pr_{}[] to cardinality
        
        -- Step 6: Apply Inductive Hypothesis for r_last ∈ R*
        have h_line_close_to_C_m : ∀ (r : R_star_set),
          jointProximityNat (u := affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r.val) (e := e) (C := MC) := by
          intro r_in_Rstar
          -- Use the lemma proven earlier
          apply correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor
            (ih := fun u_prev => ih (by omega) u_prev ) (u := u)
        -- Step 7: Apply Affine Gap of Interleaved Code C^(m = 2^(ϑ_sub_2 + 1))
        have h_C_m_gap := h_interleaved_gaps (2^(ϑ_sub_2 + 1)) (Nat.one_le_two_pow)
        -- Need the hypothesis Pr[...] > ε/q for h_C_m_gap
        have h_prob_line_gt_eps_div_q :
          Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[
            Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₀))
              (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₁)) (r := r),
              ((MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)))))) ≤ e
          ] > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
            -- This is implied by h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q becuz R* is a subset of the success set
            apply lt_of_le_of_lt' _ h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q
            have h_r_implies: ∀ (r : F), r ∈ R_star_set →
              Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation
                (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₀))
                (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₁)) (r := r),
                ((MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)))))) ≤ e := by
              intro r hr_in_Rstar
              specialize h_line_close_to_C_m ⟨r, hr_in_Rstar⟩
              unfold jointProximityNat at h_line_close_to_C_m
              assumption
            let Pr_le := Pr_le_Pr_of_implies (D := $ᵖ F)
              (g := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation
                (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₀))
                (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₁)) (r := r),
                ((MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)))))) ≤ e)
              (f := fun r => r ∈ R_star_set) (h_imp := h_r_implies)
            simp only at Pr_le
            omega
        -- Apply the gap property of C^m
        have h_final_gap : jointProximityNat₂
          (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₀))
          (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₁)) (e := e)
          (C := (MC ^⋈ (Fin (2^(ϑ_sub_2 + 1))))) := by
          apply h_C_m_gap (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₀))
            (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₁))
            (h_prob_line_gt_eps_div_q)
        apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
        exact h_final_gap

proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by 
  have h_main : ∃ (i j : ℕ), i < j ∧ (u i = u j ∧ u (i + 1) = u (j + 1) ∧ u (i + 2) = u (j + 2) ∧ u (i + 3) = u (j + 3)) := by

    let f : ℕ → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))

        have h₆ := hB (n + 2)
        have h₇ := hB (n + 3)
        simp only at h₄ h₅ h₆ h₇ ⊢
        constructor <;>
        (try constructor) <;>
        (try constructor) <;>
        (try constructor) <;>
        (try simp_all only [and_self, f]) 
      
      have h₄ : Set.Finite (Set.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T)) := by
        apply Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_mem_finset (Finset.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T)))
        intro x hx
        simp_all only [ge_iff_le, ne_eq, mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Icc, mem_setOf_eq, and_self]
        
      exact Set.Finite.subset h₄ h₃

        intro i j h₆
        by_cases h₇ : i = j

        · have h₈ : i < j ∨ j < i := by omega
          cases h₈ with
          | inl h₈ =>

            tauto
      have h₆ : Set.Infinite (Set.range f) := Set.infinite_range_of_injective h₅
      exact Set.not_infinite.mpr h₂ h₆
    
    obtain ⟨i, j, h₄, h₅⟩ := h₃
    refine' ⟨i, j, h₄, _⟩

  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h_eq⟩ := h_main
  have h₁ : ∀ m : ℕ, u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
    intro m
    have h₂ : ∀ m : ℕ, u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
      intro m
      induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h m ih =>
        match m with

          exact h_eq.1
          
        | 1 =>
          have h₃ := h_eq.2.1
          assumption
          
          
          
        | 2 =>
          have h₃ := h_eq.2.2.1
          omega
          
          
          
        | 3 =>
          have h₃ := h_eq.2.2.2

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have hpair : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by grind
  have hnot : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA hAc
    have he : A ∩ Aᶜ = ∅ := by
      ext x
      simp
    have h := hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc
    rw [he] at h
    exact h rfl
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := Finset.univ \ P
  have hpq : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∈ Q := by grind
  have hqp : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ Q → Aᶜ ∈ P := by grind
  have hcard : P.card = Q.card := by
    refine Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ) hpq hqp ?_ ?_
    · intro A hA
      simp
    · intro A hA
      simp
  have hsum : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    calc
      P.card + Q.card = Q.card + P.card := Nat.add_comm _ _
      _ = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := by
        simpa [Q] using Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card (Finset.subset_univ P)
      _ = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by simp
  have hn : 0 < Fintype.card S := by positivity
  have hp : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ Fintype.card S)]
  omega

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have change (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then b j else a j) =
        digits_to_num a + (b i - a i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    calc
      (∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then b j else a j) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ)) =
          ∑ j : Fin 9, (a j * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) +
            (if j = i then (b j - a j) else 0) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [hj] <;> ring
      _ = (∑ j : Fin 9, a j * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ)) +
          ∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then (b j - a j) else 0) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) :=
        Finset.sum_add_distrib
      _ = _ := by simp only [ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
  have hde := (hrelation d e).mp h.1 |>.2
  have hef := (hrelation e f).mp h.2 |>.2
  have h₁ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d := by
    intro i
    have := hde i
    rw [change d e i] at this
    convert this using 1 <;> abel
  have h₂ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - e i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e := by
    intro i
    have := hef i
    rw [change e f i] at this
    convert this using 1 <;> abel
  let A : ℤ := ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)
  have hsum : 7 ∣ A + 9 * digits_to_num d := by
    have := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => h₁ i)
    convert this using 1 <;> simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Int.nsmul_eq_mul,
    Nat.cast_ofNat, A] <;> norm_num
  have hnum : digits_to_num e = digits_to_num d + A := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    dsimp only [A]
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin 9, e i * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)) =
          ∑ i : Fin 9, (d i * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        ring
      _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have h7d : 7 ∣ (7 : ℤ) * digits_to_num d := ⟨digits_to_num d, by exact rfl⟩
  have hsum' : 7 ∣ A + 2 * digits_to_num d := by
    have := dvd_sub hsum h7d
    convert this using 1 <;> ring
  have htotal : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d := by
    rw [hnum]
    convert hsum' using 1 <;> ring
  have hprod : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    intro i
    have hleft : 7 ∣ (f i - e i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) - digits_to_num d := by
      have := dvd_sub (h₂ i) htotal
      convert this using 1 <;> ring
    have := dvd_add hleft (h₁ i)
    convert this using 1 <;> ring
  intro i
  have hp : (7 : ℕ).Prime := by decide
  have hpow : ¬ (7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    intro h
    have hn : (7 : ℕ) ∣ 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast h
    have : (7 : ℕ) ∣ 10 := Nat.Prime.dvd_of_dvd_pow hp hn
    norm_num at this
  have hsplit := (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by norm_num : Nat.Prime (Int.natAbs (7 : ℤ)))).dvd_mul.mp (hprod i)
  have hdiv : (7 : ℤ) ∣ f i - d i := hsplit.resolve_right hpow
  have hn : 7 ∣ -(f i - d i) := dvd_neg.mpr hdiv
  convert hn using 1 <;> ring
